newsitem.title: USA: Treasury's Rubin declines comment on Fed rates.
newsitem.headline: Treasury's Rubin declines comment on Fed rates.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin brushed aside a question on a possible interest rate hike following Tuesday's meeting of Federal Reserve policy makers.
Asked at a White House briefing if he was worried about the prospect of a rate hike, Rubin replied, "I don't worry about much in life."
A regular meeting of the central bank's Federal Open Market Committee is currently underway. An announcement updating Fed monetary policy is expected at around 1415 EST/1815 GMT.
